case.title: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH. Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation. Need: 23400 pc a year. Category goal: secure supply of a bottleneck part: coverage of the full need and a supplier that stays healthy come first. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 42 days). There is no fallback supplier: without a deal the demand is bought at the fallback price. Must-haves: volume_per_year >= 22230. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70410.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a volume of 19890 pcs per year at a price of €32.20 per unit. The requested contract term is 12 months, and our Lieferzeit is 54 days. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to proceeding according to our standard commercial procedure upon receipt of your confirmation.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

message.subject: Re: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
message.body:
Dear Segment Manager,

thank you for your offer.
Our bottom-up estimate of your unit cost for part:340010 is EUR 24.31 (cost:340010), before any margin.
Our volume forecast for part:340010 changed by +10.1% (fc:340010@2026-09).
We would like to work with you on this and can do EUR 26.40 per unit on the attached terms.

Kind regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

response.subject: Re: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
response.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We note your cost estimate and volume forecast. However, our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown.

This is our letztes Angebot. Please decide. Our offer is valid for 7 days.

Our Angebot stands at a price of €33.90 per unit, Lieferzeit 42 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months. Our Lieferzeit is 42 days. A 42-day lead time requires capacity provisions that would increase the price.

Alternatively, we offer a price of €32.00 per unit, Lieferzeit 54 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months. We accept the 36-month contract and higher volume, but must revert the lead time to 54 days to offer a unit price of €32.00.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
